description: Development stage manifest. Each stage is one workstream of the project; each item within a stage is one concrete piece of work. done:true fills a tiny segment on that stage's bar, done:false leaves it hollow.

stages.label: Documentation
stages.blurb: The real GDD file tree — 18 categories, 325 files, straight from the project's own docs/ folder.

stages.label: Concept Art
stages.blurb: Prompt files populating the concept art folder — characters, environments, props.

stages.label: World
stages.blurb: Regions, biomes, settlements, and points of interest across the continent.

stages.label: Lore
stages.blurb: Myths, histories, bloodlines, and the timeline binding it all together.

stages.label: Gameplay Systems
stages.blurb: Combat, quests, traversal, and the core moment-to-moment loop.

stages.label: Economy
stages.blurb: Currency, crafting, trade routes, and the systems that keep the market alive.

stages.label: Technical
stages.blurb: Server architecture, data schema, pipelines, and internal tooling.

stages.label: Music
stages.blurb: The 168-track Suno documentation system, region by region and cue by cue.

stages.label: Factions
stages.blurb: Structure, doctrine, and reputation rules for every faction in Elysium.

stages.label: Systems & Progression
stages.blurb: Classes, professions, housing, and the long-tail endgame loop.

stages.label: Marketing & Devlog
stages.blurb: The 180-day Instagram devlog script plus trailer and press materials.
